label: A judgment of one diagnosis by Claude as a judge (klaxon.judge): a model's, not a rule's or a person's. It saw the right answer and the remedy of the system the diagnosis was made on, and the whole diagnosis; never which model wrote it, nor the rule's verdict. A recorded response, in judge-recording.jsonl.

right_answer.cause: the provider's charge and refund API hangs (5 s, then 503), and our payments API has no circuit breaker: every payment waits through 3 timed-out attempts, the API's worker threads fill up, and even its health checks slow down
right_answer.remedy: it ends when the provider recovers; a circuit breaker would fail fast meanwhile and keep the API answering (planned for week 4)

judgment.why: It identifies the hanging provider payments/refunds API, the 3 timed-out attempts per request with no fail-fast path, and workers tied up so payments-api's health check fails, while marking the unconfirmed parts as open.
